_about: Reviewed DATA for aletheia.study_observe: public APIs a study may read, described as a URL pattern, the hosts it may call and the fields it yields. Adding a platform is an edit here, never code. Every entry reads only public data, anonymously, within the platform's published rate limits; nothing here logs in, writes or spends. robots.txt governs pages and feeds, not documented API endpoints; a domain whose terms forbid automation (config/site_skills.json manual_only) is refused before any call.

sources.describe: a public GitHub repository: its counts, its README and its release cadence, through GitHub's public REST API (anonymous, 60 requests an hour)
